**STEP 3 - Items:** Whole almonds only. No oil, dressing, or sauce is visible.

**STEP 4 - Area:** The almond pile covers the central part of the plate, about 17% of the vessel area (≈ 53 cm²).

**STEP 5 - Volume:** Pile height is about 1.2 cm on average, with some layering. 53 cm² × 1.2 cm ≈ 64 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Nuts are not in the density table. Whole almonds pack loosely, so I use 0.6 g/ml. 64 ml × 0.6 ≈ 38 g, rounded to 40 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Almonds are about 579 kcal/100 g. 40 g × 5.79 ≈ 232 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** I count roughly 35 almonds. At about 1.2 g each, that is about 42 g, which agrees with the 40 g estimate. A small snack amount on a side plate is plausible.

Total: about 40 g, about 230 kcal.
